title: Mara and the Choir
author: Hazel Zhou
blurb: Lena Nakamura, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
